newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Hering to launch $50-mln, 8-yr Eurobond. [CORRECTED 19:44 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Hering to launch $50-mln, 8-yr Eurobond. [CORRECTED 19:44 GMT]

text.p: Brazil's Companhia Hering, the holding firm for Hering Textil SA and Ceval Alimentos SA, plans to launch a $50 million, eight-year Eurobond next week, a co-lead manager for the issue said.

Luiz Fernando Fleury, executive director of Banco Marka's investment division, told Reuters the Central Bank has approved the issue and the launching shortly after next week's road show to promote the deal (corrects timeframe). Settlement is set for Oct 16.

The bonds will have put and call options at both the third and fifth years and are expected to yield in the mid-500 basis points range over the three-year U.S. treasury (corrects range), he said. Banco Marka and Deutsche Morgan Grenfell are joint lead managers for the deal and Deutsche also is bookrunner for the deal (corrects arrangements).
Bond proceeds would be used to strengthen working capital for both Hering and Ceval and to roll over an existing $50 million Eurobond set to expire in three weeks, Fleury said.
A European roadshow to promote the issue will kick off Monday in London and be in Switzerland on Tuesday, he added.
Senior management is expected to be on hand.
